testPackages.title: seam extraction + REG/pin tests
testPackages.brief: Extract location-tracker.native.ts's current unmapped heading/speed construction verbatim into a named seam module both call sites call (behaviour-preserving). T1/T2 test the seam; T3/T4 test PostLocationDto's validation with the new accuracy field (whitelist violation pre-fix, Min(0) violation post-fix for a negative value); T5 pins every existing DTO case. Exact setup/oracle in bug-test-plan.md, including T4's dual-assertion construction.

packages.title: mobile sentinel mapping
packages.brief: buildLocationPayload's body maps negative-or-null heading/speed to null, converts valid speed m/s->km/h, passes accuracy through when >= 0 else omits it. Both duplicate call sites in location-tracker.native.ts spread its return alongside their existing lat/lng/runId fields.

packages.title: DTO + persistence
packages.brief: Add @IsOptional() @Type(()=>Number) @IsNumber() @Min(0) accuracy?: number to PostLocationDto (no @Max). recordLocation's create() call gains accuracy: dto.accuracy. heading/speedKph's existing @Min(0)/@Max decorators are unchanged.

packages.title: close-out bookkeeping
packages.brief: F25.jsonl: B185 -> proven. Code-map surgical entries for the 3 touched/new files + _meta.json + CHANGELOG bullet. LESSONS.md is NOT appended again (L-047 already covers B185 via Run A); _meta.json gets updatedAt bumped only. Precondition: Run A's WP-DOCS must already have landed.

targets.behavior: negative/null heading and speed sentinels map to null
accuracy is optional, >= 0, and does not relax heading/speedKph bounds
